question.text: The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) launched by NITI Aayog in 2018 covers how many underperforming districts and focuses on which thematic priorities?

answer.text: 112 districts — health, education, agriculture, financial inclusion and infrastructure via a data-driven outcome-based approach
250 districts — exclusively focused on urban-slum development
50 districts — exclusively focused on climate action

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.9.2, NITI Aayog identified 112 aspirational districts in 2018. The ADP prioritises health, education, agriculture, financial inclusion and infrastructure via a data-driven outcome-based approach, with monthly ranking. The Trap: Option A under-counts to 100 and under-covers themes. Option C over-counts and misdirects theme. Option D is entirely fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 8 (Case Studies) where SEs operating in aspirational districts feature prominently. SIAs should verify whether the SE's operational geography overlaps with ADP districts — this strengthens the target-underserved-segment narrative.
